compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- dd-2 (5003): running the validation harness against the fixture produces measured before/after fk_grade, active_voice rate, and banned_words_found counts
- dd-3 (5003): the harness reports PASS only when average fk_grade decreases by >=1 grade level, active_voice rate increases by >=20 percentage points, and banned_words_found count drops to 0
- dd-4 (5003): the harness re-runs idempotently and is wired into the epic's closure checks
- dd-5 (5003): unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic

## Description
Implement plugins/dso/tests/dogfood-gov-copy-harness.sh that:
1. Measures the bad-copy fixture's baseline via the deterministic post-processor (story 67c1)
2. Dispatches gov-copy-writer (story 074b) against the fixture in a temp directory
3. Re-measures the produced artifact via the same post-processor
4. Asserts the before/after acceptance bar: avg fk_grade decreases by >=1 grade level, active_voice rate increases by >=20 percentage points, banned_words_found count drops to 0
5. Emits a human-readable report (stdout) and exits non-zero on any threshold miss
6. Is idempotent: re-running on the same fixture produces consistent measurements (baseline is recomputed each run, not pinned)

Wire the harness into the epic's Closure Checks section so completion-verifier surfaces dogfood validation as a closure gate.

## Test Approach (Given/When/Then)
Given the bad-copy fixture from T1 and the post-processor from story 67c1; When the harness runs against the fixture; Then it produces measured baseline values, dispatches gov-copy-writer to a temp dir, re-measures the produced artifact, and exits 0 only when ALL three acceptance bars hold: avg fk_grade decreases by >=1, active_voice rate increases by >=20pp, banned_words_found drops to 0. A regression test deliberately mutates the harness's threshold check to one stricter than gov-copy-writer can satisfy and asserts the harness exits non-zero — proving the assertion is load-bearing.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff format --check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] Harness exists and is executable
  Verify: test -x plugins/dso/tests/dogfood-gov-copy-harness.sh
- [ ] Harness produces before/after measurements
  Verify: bash plugins/dso/tests/dogfood-gov-copy-harness.sh | grep -qE 'before|baseline' && bash plugins/dso/tests/dogfood-gov-copy-harness.sh | grep -qE 'after|improved'
- [ ] Harness exits 0 when acceptance bar holds, non-zero otherwise
  Verify: bash plugins/dso/tests/test-dogfood-harness-assertions.sh
- [ ] Harness wired into epic Closure Checks section
  Verify: grep -q 'dogfood-gov-copy-harness' /dev/null || .claude/scripts/dso ticket show 5003-75a8-ccfc-4773 | grep -q 'dogfood'
- [ ] Test registered in .test-index
  Verify: grep -q 'test-dogfood-harness-assertions.sh' plugins/dso/tests/.test-index
